tools.name: make_decision_tree
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a decision tree drawn or solved: options of a decision, chance events with probabilities, and payoffs, for example "which option has the higher expected value" or "draw a decision tree for launching this product". Takes the tree as an indented outline or a JSON node list

tools.name: check_tree
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a decision tree checked without a drawing, for example "do my probabilities add up to 1" or "is anything missing in this tree". Takes the same outline or node list and objective as make_decision_tree. Returns, for each chance node, the sum of its branch probabilities as
